definitions: To push a sharp or pointed object into or through something.
To attach something to something else using an adhesive substance.
To become fixed in a particular position or unable to move.
To tolerate or endure something unpleasant.
To remain loyal to a particular person, group, or principle.
examples: She stuck the needle into the fabric.
Stick the poster on the wall.
The car got stuck in the mud.
I don't know how much more I can stick.
He stuck by his friends through thick and thin.
